****More Good Reasons to Work for Visteon Focusing on the Future****
**Our company strategy focuses on leading the evolution of automotive digital cockpits and safety solutions. This strategy is driven by constant innovation, and you will support our efforts through your role. We are recognized across the industry for innovation. We have a strong book of business that is expected to drive future growth, along with a customer base that includes almost every automotive manufacturer in the world.** 
****Company Culture****
**Working at Visteon is a journey in which our employees can develop their strengths and advance their careers while making a difference globally. Join us and help change the world and how we interact with our vehicles. Visteon is where the best technical talent creates the future. Learn more about our culture here.** 
****About Visteon****
**Visteon is advancing mobility through innovative technology solutions that enable a software\-defined future. Our state\-of\-the\-art product portfolio merges digital cockpit innovations, advanced displays, AI\-enhanced software solutions, and integrated EV architecture solutions. With expertise spanning passenger vehicles, commercial transportation, and two\-wheelers, Visteon partners with global automakers to create safer, cleaner, and more connected journeys. Headquartered in Van Buren Township, Michigan, Visteon operates in 17 countries, employing a global network of innovation centers and manufacturing facilities. title: Integration Engineer - Mediation
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 We are looking for a highly skilled Telecom Mediation Specialist with strong expertise in the deployment, integration, configuration, development, and troubleshooting of Telecom Mediation platforms.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience on deployment of Mediation Platform across Bare Metal, Virtualized, Cloud, or Containerized environments, with a strong understanding of CDR processing, Online protocol knowledge, data transformation, mediation rules, network\-element integration, and upstream/downstream systems.
   

  

 Experience with automation, Kafka/real\-time streaming, cloud technologies, and Gen\-AI tools will be an added advantage.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Deploy, install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot mediation platforms across Bare Metal, VM, Cloud, and Container/Kubernetes environments.
* Configure and manage mediation workflows for high\-volume CDR processing.
* Integrate mediation platforms with various Network, IT, Core, Packet Core, Charging, Billing, and downstream systems.
* Design and develop mediation solutions for Charging \& Billing, IMS/VoLTE, 4G, and 5G use cases.
* Perform end\-to\-end data reconciliation across network elements, mediation, and downstream systems.
* Develop and maintain mediation components, utilities, scripts, and automation frameworks.
* Use Java, C, Python, Shell, and/or Perl for development and automation activities.
* Build, deploy, and develop real\-time streaming applications using Apache Kafka or Apache Flink.
* Explore and leverage Gen\-AI tools to improve engineering productivity, troubleshooting, automation, and solution development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with telecom mediation platforms such as Ericsson Mediation OR Nokia/Comptel Mediation OR Amdocs Mediation/Oracle RBM
* Strong understanding of CDR structures, processing flows, mediation rules, parsing, transformation, and enrichment.
* Experience in end\-to\-end mediation solution design/development for Charging \& Billing, IMS/VoLTE, and/or 5G.
* Thorough understanding of ASN.1/JSON/AVRO Schema/Parquet structures.
* Strong proficiency in SQL.
* Hands\-on experience with Java, C, Python, or equivalent programming languages.
* Experience with data parsing, transformation, ETL processes, and API integrations.
* Strong understanding of large\-scale data processing.
* Experience in building, deploying, configuring, or troubleshooting Apache Kafka / Apache Flink environments.
* Understanding of real\-time/event\-driven streaming architectures.
* Experience developing real\-time streaming applications using Kafka is highly desirable.


**The skills you bring:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 5–12 years of relevant experience in Telecom Mediation deployment, development, integration, or solution engineering.
* Experience with cloud\-based mediation solutions.
* Recognized certifications in AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or Kafka will be an advantage.
* Experience in 5G mediation, IMS/VoLTE, real\-time charging, and cloud\-native telecom architectures will be highly desirable.
* Exposure to Automation and Gen\-AI technologies is an added advantage.

title: Automation Test Lead - PEGA
description:
**Job Description:**
* Lead the automation testing strategy and implementation for enterprise Pega applications.
* Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks for UI, API and end\-to\-end testing.
* Identify suitable candidates for automation and maximise regression coverage.
* Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and establish automated quality gates.
* Lead and develop the automation and quality engineering team.


**Key Responsibilities:**
* Define automation strategy, roadmap, tooling selection and ROI model.
* Design and maintain reusable automation frameworks \- hybrid, data\-driven, keyword\-driven, BDD/Cucumber, Page Object Model.
* Develop automated UI/API test scripts, handling Pega's dynamic DOM in Constellation and traditional UI.
* Lead automation of Pega\-specific layers \- Pega Scenario Testing, Pega Automated Unit Testing (AUT) and rule\-level coverage.
* Automate and optimise regression test suites; drive regression cycle time down and coverage up.
* Integrate automation with CI/CD \- Deployment Manager, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Own test data management strategy, synthetic data generation, masking and environment refresh coordination.
* Manage test data and environments.
* Lead performance and load test strategy (JMeter, LoadRunner, Gatling) and interpret Pega PAL, DB Trace and PDC output.
* Analyse automation results and investigate automation failures and flakiness.
* Lead defect triage, root\-cause analysis and prevention actions.
* Track and report automation coverage, pass rate, execution time and quality metrics.
* Establish testing standards, code review practice and version control discipline for test assets.
* Mentor automation engineers and allocate work across the team.
* Collaborate with Pega developers and architects on testability and shift\-left practice.
* Provide quality sign\-off and go/no\-go recommendations at release gates.
* Evaluate emerging tooling, including AI\-assisted test generation and self\-healing automation.


**Technical Qualification: Minimum knowledge, skills, abilities needed:**
* Strong automation\-testing experience, including framework design from scratch.
* Experience testing Pega applications.
* Experience with Pega Scenario Testing and Pega Automated Unit Testing (AUT).
* Strong API testing experience.
* UI automation experience.
* Knowledge of Selenium/Playwright/Cypress or equivalent.
* Experience with REST API automation (RestAssured, Karate, Postman/Newman, SoapUI).
* Programming experience in Java, Python, JavaScript or equivalent.
* CI/CD experience and pipeline ownership.
* SQL/database testing knowledge.
* Git and version control discipline for test assets.
* Agile/Scrum experience.
* Team leadership and mentoring experience.


**Educational Qualification:**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* Master's degree (M.Tech / MCA) is an advantage.


**Preferred Qualification:**
* 7\+ years testing experience.
* 5\+ years automation experience.
* 3\+ years Pega testing experience.
* 2\+ years leading QA/automation teams.
* ISTQB Foundation certification.
* ISTQB Advanced Test Automation Engineer or Test Manager certification.
* Certified Pega System Architect (CPSA / CSA) is strongly recommended.
* Experience with Pega Constellation testing.
* Experience integrating automation into DevOps pipelines.
* DevOps or cloud certification (Docker, Kubernetes/CKAD, Azure DevOps Engineer, AWS/Azure Associate).
* Performance testing experience is advantageous.
